top_signals.title: Soaring Fuel Prices Threaten to Push More Airlines Into Bankruptcy
top_signals.summary: More airlines could soon collapse, the boss of Easyjet has warned, as soaring fuel costs push carriers to the brink. Kenton Jarvis, the company’s chief executive, said Easyjet had sought to swerve the surge in jet fuel prices via a process known as hedging, in which fuel contracts are bought in advance to avoid exposure to short-term price volatility.  As much as 69 per cent of the firm’s fuel consumption for the year to September had been hedged at “favourable rates” compared to current prices, Jarvis said.
